seoTitle: Hanoi to Da Nang — flight of 1 hour 20, or train
seoDescription: The flight is about 1 hour 20 minutes each way, before the airport rides. The five SE trains from Hanoi to Da Nang take 15 hours 23 minutes to 17 hours 3 minutes.

faqs.q: Is Da Nang back to Hanoi the same trip?
faqs.a: Yes. This page covers both directions. The return flight is also about 1 hour 20 minutes. The five northbound trains take 16 hours 8 minutes to 18 hours 41 minutes.
